notice.label: Cookie notice
notice.title: We use essential cookies
notice.body: Applika.dev only uses cookies that are strictly necessary to keep you signed in and to protect your session. No analytics, advertising, or tracking cookies are used. <link>Learn more</link>.

policy.title: Cookie Policy
policy.whatBody: Cookies are small text files placed on your device by the websites you visit. They are widely used to make sites work, or work more efficiently, and to provide information to the site owner.
policy.usedBody: {name} uses only strictly necessary cookies, plus one preference cookie that remembers the language you choose. These cookies are required for the site to function and to keep your session secure. We do not use cookies for analytics, advertising, profiling, or third-party tracking.
policy.accessPurpose: Short-lived signed JWT that authenticates each request while you are using the site.
policy.refreshPurpose: Opaque UUID used as a lookup key for your refresh token, which is stored server-side in Redis. Allows the short-lived access token to be renewed without making you sign in again.
policy.localePurpose: Remembers the language you chose: it holds en (English) or pt-BR (Portuguese, Brazil), so every page opens in that language, signed in or not. Set only when you pick a language; nothing is stored on your account.
policy.thirdPartyBody: None. {name} does not embed third-party services that set cookies on your device.
policy.managingBody: Because the cookies we set are strictly necessary, there is no consent toggle to offer: disabling them would prevent you from signing in. You can clear cookies at any time through your browser settings, but doing so will sign you out.
policy.managingLocale: The language cookie is only set when you choose a language. If cookies are blocked, your choice lasts for the page you are on, and the next page follows your browser's language.
policy.changesBody: If our cookie practices change, we will update this page and revise the date above.
policy.footer: Questions? See our <link>home page</link> for contact details.

landing.heroBody: Track applications, monitor your pipeline, and turn your job search into a data-driven process with real-time analytics.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to take control of your job search?
landing.ctaBody: Join hundreds of job seekers who track smarter, not harder. Free forever.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to manage your job search

track.title: Track Applications
track.description: Keep all your job applications organized in one place with company, role, platform, and salary details.

pipeline.title: Step-by-Step Pipeline
pipeline.description: Follow every application through its hiring stages — from applied to offer — with custom steps and dates.

conversion.title: Conversion Analytics
conversion.description: See which stages you pass most often, average days per step, and your overall success rate.

trends.title: Trend Insights
trends.description: Visualize your application volume over time and compare active vs passive sourcing strategies.

borderless.title: Borderless Sign-in
borderless.description: Sign in with your Borderless account. BASE and PSP members share biweekly reports with their community.

finalization.title: Finalization & Feedback
finalization.description: Close out applications with outcome tracking so you can learn from every process.

landing.howTitle: From sign-up to insights in minutes

signIn.title: Sign in with Borderless
signIn.description: Use your Borderless email and password. Your account is ready instantly, with your BASE or PSP membership on it.

add.title: Add your applications
add.description: Log each application with company, role, platform, and salary. Track every detail that matters.

analyze.title: Analyze & optimize
analyze.description: Watch your dashboard light up with conversion rates, trends, and actionable insights.

landing.openSourceTitle: Transparent by design, built for the community
landing.openSourceBody: Applika is fully open source. We believe job seekers deserve tools that respect their privacy and put them in control.

open.title: Built in the Open
open.description: Every line of code is public. Read it, audit it, learn from it — full transparency from day one.

community.title: Community Driven
community.description: Feature requests, bug reports, and pull requests are all welcome. Shape the tool you use every day.

matheus.quote: Applika has a very simple UI that captures extremely important metrics in the application process!

pietro.quote: Having every application tracked with stages and analytics changed how I approach job hunting. I always know exactly where each process stands and what to focus on next.

joao.quote: Applika showed me exactly what I was getting wrong in my applications, and honestly, that changed everything for me.
